review_candidates.description: Job Description What if you could do the kind of work the world needs? At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. As a Project Manager at WSP in the PMCM Rail team you will be responsible for enabling the delivery of complex rail projects of regional, national, and international significance. You will ensure that the projects are delivered safely to a high-quality, in a timely manner, and compliant with budget. At WSP, our Project Managers are individuals who are adaptable in various situations and possess an innovative mindset, willing to take on new challenges and are comfortable in working within significant and complex projects, embedded into the client’s team. We also collaborate closely with internal multi-disciplinary project teams and, to deliver most effectively, we utilise WSP offices, client offices and/or site locations to deliver programmes of strategic regional and national importance. Our culture encourages and supports a successful work-life balance and we encourage all our people to embrace this approach. You will be based in one of our modern, vibrant offices, situated in great city centre locations across the UK. WSP actively supports flexible working with the expectation for you to be in an office environment a minimum of three days a week to support and integrate with your colleagues and clients. You will, on occasion, visit sites. With WSP you have the exceptional opportunity to take the next step in your career, build on your experience and qualifications and achieve your ambitions. We offer excellent support in personal development and growth as part of our local teams and across the wider WSP business, including, for example, the opportunity to gain formal project management qualifications through the APM pathway. Your Team We are a diverse, inclusive and enthusiastic team of Project, Commercial and Design Managers working in the Rail sector, focussed on the common goal of delivering solutions for our clients. Our passion comes from creating and shaping the built environment through tailored project delivery as we strive to be the best in class. A Little More About Your Role… Coordinating relevant disciplines through project meetings and target-led workshops, enabling critical issues to be resolved in a timely manner, and that project meets safety, functional and regulatory requirements. Establishing robust processes and procedures to manage the project, in conjunction with the client’s team. Acting as primary point of contact for client, ensuring their needs and expectations are met through both the design and construction phases. Developing and managing client and stakeholder relationships, through effective listening and influencing skills. Compiling monthly project reports and data-based scenarios, to provide senior managers clarity of project position. Engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including regulatory bodies, local authorities, and community groups. Facilitating regular project meetings, presentations, and progress reports. Addressing stakeholder concerns and manage expectations effectively. Managing contract in accordance with contract rules of engagement (including NEC3 & 4). Managing project budgets, including cost estimation, tracking, and reporting. Optimising resource utilisation and ensure financial performance aligns with project goals. Reviewing and approving project expenditures and invoices. Managing changes and delays affecting the project and ensuring these are resolved or mitigated accordingly and ensuring project management processes are consistently improved and implemented, e.g. change control. Identifying and mitigating potential risks associated with the design and construction phases and establishing risk mitigation measures to suit. Dealing with RFIs, early warnings, and general communications to reduce project risk and ensure successful project delivery. Being a safety leader, driving safety performance and compliance with Construction Design Management (CDM) regulations. Discharge CDM duties as required by the client. Ensuring all activities are conducted in a safe and environmentally responsible manner, adhering to corporate governance and standards. Defining project scope, goals, and deliverables in collaboration with client and stakeholders. Liaising with Planner in developing detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, resource allocation, and risk management. Overseeing project execution, ensuring adherence to project plans and schedules. Monitoring project progress, identify potential issues, and implement corrective actions. Driving innovative design and construction solutions and implement processes to enhance project efficiency and productivity. Evaluate and integrate new technologies and methodologies to improve project performance. What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate… A degree in a relevant engineering or management discipline (such as project or construction management, engineering, science, or building). Chartered membership of a relevant professional body, or nearing completion of this status would be advantageous. APM / MSP / PMI / PRINCE2 / Six Sigma certifications are considered beneficial. Working experience of managing NEC3/4 contracts Experience in project management, including Technical and Project management and Project Controls. Experience working on significant projects with demonstrated client-side project delivery (design and build). Experience working with organisations such as Transport for Wales, Network Rail and other rail-related entities is seen as advantageous. Proven ability to manage successful workstreams within a multi-disciplinary delivery team. Demonstrates curiosity, is solution-focused, and responsive to client issues. Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world. With us, you can. Apply today. Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team. About Us We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? Work-life balance At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community. Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK. Inclusivity & Belonging We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity. Health & Wellbeing We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme. Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package. Flex your time To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day. We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you. Your development We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership. #WeAreWSP Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

review_candidates.title: Performance Marketer
review_candidates.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: NNC is looking for a Performance Marketer who can turn advertising investment into measurable results through strategic planning, hands-on media buying, data analysis and continuous optimisation. This role goes beyond launching advertisements. We are looking for someone who understands the full performance journey, from audience targeting and creative development to landing pages, tracking, conversions and reporting. You will manage paid campaigns across NNC's client portfolio, including major events, government entities, cultural institutions and consumer-facing campaigns. You should be able to independently manage advertising platforms, diagnose performance issues, identify growth opportunities and make recommendations supported by data. Key Responsibilities 1. Performance Strategy & Media Planning Develop paid media strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences and measurable outcomes. Translate briefs into campaign plans, KPIs, channel strategies, budgets and forecasts. Plan full-funnel campaigns covering awareness, consideration, lead generation, conversion and remarketing. Research audience behaviour, competitors and market opportunities to inform targeting and media allocation. Develop media plans for events, launches, registrations, applications and ongoing campaigns. 2. Paid Media Buying & Optimisation Independently manage campaigns across Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat and other relevant platforms. Set up and optimise targeting, bidding, placements, budgets and creative variations. Manage awareness, traffic, video, lead-generation and conversion campaigns across multiple client accounts. Monitor spending, delivery and performance against agreed KPIs. Analyse CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, ROAS, reach, frequency and conversion rates . Diagnose underperformance across audiences, creative, bidding, placements and conversion journeys. Conduct structured A/B testing and identify opportunities to scale, restructure or reduce spending. Troubleshoot account issues, disapprovals and delivery limitations. 3. Tracking, Analytics & Attribution Implement and validate tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API and Google Ads . Define and monitor conversion events across websites, landing pages, forms and registration journeys. Maintain accurate UTM structures and campaign measurement frameworks. Work with Development and CRM teams to resolve tracking discrepancies. Understand attribution limitations and distinguish platform-reported results from verified conversions. Maintain appropriate data privacy and consent practices. 4. Conversion Rate Optimisation Analyse the complete user journey from advertisement to final conversion. Identify friction affecting registrations, applications, enquiries, purchases and lead submissions. Recommend improvements to landing pages, forms, messaging and calls to action. Collaborate with UX/UI, Development and Creative teams to improve conversion efficiency. Evaluate drop-off patterns and test improvements to user experience and campaign performance. 5. Creative Performance & Testing Collaborate with Art Directors, Copywriters, Multimedia Designers and Social Media teams to develop effective advertising creative. Translate performance insights into clear, actionable creative briefs. Test hooks, visuals, messaging, formats and calls to action. Identify creative fatigue and recommend new concepts or approaches. Explain which creative elements work, for which audiences, and why. Contribute to performance-led creative development from the planning stage. 6. Events & High-Volume Campaigns Plan and manage paid campaigns for major events, conferences, exhibitions and cultural programmes . Develop strategies for ticket sales, registrations, applications and high-volume lead generation. Allocate media investment around campaign phases, event dates and conversion deadlines. Monitor cost per registration, application, qualified lead or ticket purchase. Coordinate with website, ticketing, CRM and technical teams to validate conversion journeys. Adjust campaigns based on audience demand, available capacity and operational requirements. Implement remarketing and conversion-recovery campaigns where appropriate. 7. Reporting, Budgets & Client Communication Prepare accurate reports and dashboards using Looker Studio, GA4 and advertising-platform data . Explain campaign results against objectives, budgets and business outcomes. Identify performance drivers, risks and opportunities. Distinguish verified findings from assumptions and hypotheses. Manage approved budgets, spending forecasts and media allocations. Recommend budget adjustments based on performance and campaign priorities. Support Account Managers in client reviews and planning discussions. Present clear recommendations rather than simply reporting numbers. 8. AI, Automation & Campaign Ownership Use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and comparable AI tools for research, analysis, reporting and productivity. Apply AI to explore audience insights, performance patterns and testing hypotheses. Work confidently with automated advertising solutions such as Meta Advantage+ and Google Performance Max . Critically evaluate AI-generated insights and automated recommendations against actual campaign data. Explore opportunities for reporting and workflow automation while protecting confidential client information. Own campaigns from planning and launch through optimisation and final reporting. Coordinate with Growth, Creative, Social Media, Account Management and Development teams. Anticipate risks, communicate dependencies and resolve campaign issues proactively. What We're Looking For 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, paid media buying or digital advertising. Proven experience independently managing campaigns with measurable performance objectives. Strong expertise in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads . Experience with TikTok, LinkedIn, Snapchat or other relevant advertising platforms. Experience managing multiple accounts, preferably within a creative, digital or integrated communications agency. Strong understanding of targeting, bidding, campaign structures and optimisation. Hands-on experience with GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, Conversions API and conversion tracking . Experience with lead generation, conversion campaigns and funnel optimisation. Strong understanding of advertising metrics, attribution and conversion quality. Ability to analyse performance and make independent optimisation decisions. Experience with creative testing and performance-led campaign development. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with reporting dashboards. Ability to manage advertising budgets responsibly. Strong analytical thinking, commercial awareness and problem-solving skills. Excellent organisation and ability to manage competing deadlines. Professional English communication skills. Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis and marketing automation. Strong Advantages Experience managing UAE or GCC campaigns. Experience with government or semi-government clients. Experience with large-scale events, ticketing and registrations. Experience managing substantial advertising budgets. Arabic proficiency. Experience with CRM integrations, offline conversions and lead-quality reporting. Knowledge of server-side tracking, first-party data and advanced reporting. Google Ads, Meta or other relevant certifications. What Success Looks Like You don't start with the advertising platform. You start with the client's objective . You understand the difference between impressions, engagement, leads and meaningful business outcomes. You don't consider a campaign successful because it generated cheap leads if those leads are not qualified. You know when to scale, when to test and when to stop. You can identify whether a campaign is struggling because of its audience, creative, landing page, tracking or conversion process. You don't rely blindly on platform-reported results. You verify performance against actual outcomes. You turn performance data into specific creative recommendations rather than simply requesting more advertisements. You understand how advertising, creative, technology and the user journey work together. You manage budgets responsibly and identify inefficient spending early. You use AI and automation to improve decisions, not replace your judgment. You don't send reports full of metrics without explaining what they mean. You can tell an Account Manager or client what happened, why it may have happened, what remains uncertain and what should happen next . You anticipate problems rather than discovering them after the campaign ends. Clients trust your recommendations. Creative teams understand your feedback. Account Managers can rely on your numbers. And every campaign becomes smarter because of your involvement. Life at NNC At NNC, we're a collective of 90+ passionate people brought together by a shared ambition to create exceptional work for our clients and partners. We operate in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where people are trusted to take ownership, solve problems and contribute beyond traditional job descriptions. What We Offer Competitive salary. Top-tier health insurance with comprehensive medical coverage. An overtime policy that respects your time. Menstrual leave supporting employee well-being. An agile, cross-functional working environment. A diverse team representing more than 16 nationalities.
